definitions.dominates: at least as good on both axes and strictly better on one
definitions.frontier: configurations not dominated by any other measured configuration

notes: Axes: mean throughput (fps_from_mean = 1000 / mean end-to-end latency) against tail latency (p95), both from the same measured runs (reports/benchmarks/*_raw.csv).
Measured on CPU (AMD Ryzen 9 5900HS, torch 2.14.0+cpu) over a real street scene, 120 measured frames per configuration after a 5-frame warm-up, repeats with fresh tracker state.
Only one configuration is non-dominated, so all three recommendations refer to it.

gate_set.name: runtime-baseline
notes: Thresholds derived from the measured CPU run in reports/benchmarks (real street scene, warm-up excluded); 5% relative tolerance for run-to-run variation.
